rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT THE SEASONABLE FILING OF A MOTION FOR RECONSIDERATION AND/OR APPEAL SHALL STAY THE EXECUTION OF THE CHALLENGED ORDER OF DECISION
rows.abstract: Provides that a seasonable motion for reconsideration, appeal or petition for review shall stay execution of the challenged order or decision until the rendition of a final judgement affirming the said controverted order or decision. States that due process includes the opportunity to be heard not only in the first instance but also on motion for reconsideration as appeal. This opportunity to be heard is virtually negated by the execution of the challenged order or decision pending a motion for reconsideration or appeal.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2019-07-23

rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2021-03-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2021-03-16 and received by the Senate on 2021-03-16
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROTECTING THE PHYSICAL INTEGRITY OF A CULTURAL PROPERTY, PENALIZING ANY OBSTRUCTION TO ITS VIEW AND SIGHTLINE, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT     NO. 10066 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE \"NATIONAL CULTURAL HERITAGE ACT OF 2009\"
rows.abstract:
\"Cultural Property Sightline Act\" 
Seeks to expressly prohibit any construction or real estate development that could ruin the view and sightline of any national shrine, monument, landmark and other historic edifices and structures.
Amends section 48 of RA10066  - the \"National Cultural Heritage Act of 2009\"
rows.status: Substituted by HB08829

rows.author: H028
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2021-07-28, transmitted to the Senate on 2021-07-29 and received by the Senate on 2021-07-29
rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRODUCTION, IMPORTATION, SALE, PROVISION, USE, RECOVERY, COLLECTION, RECYCLING, AND DISPOSAL OF PLASTIC PRODUCTS
rows.abstract: Seeks to regulate the production, use, recycling and disposal of plastic bags and other single-use plastics in the whole country. Provides for a gradual phase out of single-use plastics; a transition program for the shift to the use of biodegradable plastic bags; a Special Environment Fund for plastics regulation;  the role of local government units; a program for affected workers of the plastic industry; and support for affected manufacturers of plastic products for effective implementation of this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB09147

rows.author: H028
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR A COMPREHENSIVE CIVIL REGISTRATION SYSTEM
rows.abstract: Seeks to introduce a comprehensive and genuinely responsible civil registration system. Provides mechanisms for comprehensive and responsive civil registration; a Barangay Civil Registration System and free registration program for unregistered births due to distance and poverty; and  free civil registration for indigenous peoples, foundlings and children needing special protection
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on POPULATION AND FAMILY RELATIONS since 2019-07-23

rows.author: H028
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A NATIONAL LAND USE AND MANAGEMENT POLICY, PROVIDING THE IMPLEMENTING MECHANISMS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to integrate and institutionalize people´s participation and gender mainstreaming in defining the framework and guiding principles of land allocation and utilization. Provides for the mandatory participation of the stakeholders in key decision making bodies on land use policy at all levels.

Provides for the 1. Mechanism to harmonize conflicting land laws; 2. Adherence to the principle of sustainable development and just management, and utilization of natural resources; 3. Clear delineation of land use categories; 4. Protection of prime agricultural lands for food security and sufficiency; 5. Integration and institutionalizing  people´s participation in land use planning and applies the combined bottom-up top-bottom approach in land use planning; 6. National Physical Framework Plan which shall define the national strategy and objective of the country´s urban, rural, and regional development; 7. Creation of the National Spatial Database Information and Mapping Inter-Agency Support System; and 8. Final determination and ground delineation of the country´s permanent forest line and completion the Geohazard Mapping Program to effectively provide adequate and up to date information necessary for land use planning.
rows.alias_name: “National Land Use and Management Act of the Philippines.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LAND USE since 2019-07-23

rows.author: H028
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2021-02-01, transmitted to the Senate on 2021-02-02 and received by the Senate on 2021-02-02
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE SUSTAINABLE MANAGEMENT OF FOREST AND FOREST LANDS AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to set a clear and concrete policy direction in the formulation of programs for the protection and sustainable management of our forest ecosystems. Recognizes the Sustainable Forest Ecosystem Management (SFEM) strategy as the principal policy framework for all programs in the forestry sector. Prioritizes the protection and rehabilitation of our forest systems through regeneration or restoration of natural forests.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08179

rows.author: H028
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING MARINE PROTECTED AREAS IN ALL COASTAL MUNICIPALITIES AND CITIES
rows.abstract: Mandates every coastal municipality to establish, maintain and manage marine protected areas in at least 15% of their municipal waters while preserving already existing Marine Protected Areas (MPAs).  Provides for mechanisms for concerted efforts in local communities for the preservation and protection of coasts.
rows.alias_name: “Marine and Coastal Resources and Protection Act”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2019-07-23

rows.author: H028
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR STRICTER REGULATION IN THE PACKAGING, USE, SALE, DISTRIBUTION AND ADVERTISEMENT OF TOBACCO PRODUCTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9211, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE êžŒTOBACCO REGULATION ACT OF 2003êžŒ
rows.abstract: Regulates the use, sale and advertisements of tobacco products. Promotes a healthful environment and protect the citizens from the hazards of tobacco smoke in accordance with the World Health Organization Framework Convention on Tobacco Control (WHO FCTC). Amends certain provisions of Republic Act No. 9211 to make the law attunes to current demands and genuinely responsive to urgent requirement for the protection of public health against the life-threatening hazard of smokes.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2019-07-23

rows.author: H028
rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE BARANGAY UNIT BY PROVIDING ADDITIONAL BENEFITS TO BARANGAY SECURITY, HEALTH AND NUTRITION WORKERS, AMENDING PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 1569, REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160 AND REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7883, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to strengthen the barangay unit by setting the appropriate amount to be received as honoraria. Provides additional benefits and mandates capacity-building programs for our barangay volunteer workers- specifically the barangay tanod, the barangay health worker, and the barangay nutrition scholar.
rows.alias_name: “Barangay Security, Health and Nutrition Workers´ Benefits
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2019-07-23

rows.author: H028
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEFINING POLITICAL DYNASTY AND PROHIBITING THE ESTABLISHMENT THEREOF
rows.abstract: Provides for a clear and categorical definition of political dynasty and political dynasty relationships, and the prohibition thereof, thereby giving force and effect to the anti-dynasty provisions of the 1987 Constitution.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2019-07-23

rows.author: H028
rows.mother_status: Pending With Rules (Included in OB on 2020-01-28)
rows.title_full: AN ACT ENSURING THE FUNDAMENTAL EQUALITY OF MEN AND WOMEN UNDER THE LAWS ON MARRIAGE AND FAMILY RELATIONS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLES 14, 96, 124, 211, AND 225 OF EXECUTIVE ORDER 209, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE FAMILY CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Seeks to rectify the discriminatory provisions of the Family Code, namely Articles 14, 96, 124, 211, and 225 which continue to propagate the unequal status of spouses and perpetuate the obsolete concept of patriarchy within the family.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06078

rows.author: H028
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO REGULATE THE RATIONAL EXPLORATION, DEVELOPMENT AND UTILIZATION OF MINERAL RESOURCES, AND TO ENSURE THE EQUITABLE SHARING OF BENEFITS FOR THE STATE, INDIGENOUS PEOPLES AND LOCAL COMMUNITIES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to guarantee that the exploration, development and utilization of mineral resources will primarily benefit the Filipino people; prioritizes sustainable livelihood choices of communities; gives utmost importance to food security and livable conditions for the people; ensures that the gains from the mining industry would be maximized while preventing or mitigating its adverse effects; recognizes that the issue of environment and sustainable development is local and thus prioritizes local participation in decisions surrounding mining; ensures the protection and human rights of communities and individuals; and imposes harsh penalties for the violation of its provisions.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING STANDARDS FOR RESPONSIBLE MINING
rows.abstract: Prescribes standards of responsible mining, including business integrity, social responsibility, environmental responsibility, reclamation and closure and management systems; respects the human rights and aspiration of affected communities; provides safe, healthy and respectful workplaces; and avoids or minimize harm to the environment and leave positive legacies.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT PRESCRIBING URGENT RELATED MEASURES NECESSARY AND PROPER TO EFFECTIVELY ADDRESS THE TRAFFIC CRISIS IN METRO MANILA AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Grants the President the power to enter into negotiated contracts for the construction, repair, rehabilitation, improvement or maintenance of critical infrastructure projects and facilities, subject to certain requirements. Further authorizes the President to set a maximum internal rate of return of not more than twelve percent (12%)  of the house-estimated project cost provided, that any infrastructure project that has the capacity to yield said internal rate of return under commercial conditions may be undertaken on a build-operate-transfer basis or any of its variants as enumerated in Section 2 of RA 7718; provided, further, that the toll fees in the case of projects undertaken as BOT or any of its variants shall be set by the Toll Regulatory Board.

Empowers the President to reorganize the Metro Manila Development Authority (MMDA) to make it more effective, innovative and responsive to the traffic crisis in Metro Manila.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRANSPORTATION since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING ADDITIONAL PERSONAL EXEMPTION FOR INDIVIDUAL TAXPAYERS WHO TAKE CARE OF THEIR ELDERLY PARENTS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8424, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE êžŒNATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE OF 1997êžŒ
rows.abstract: Provides additional exemption of Twenty-Five Thousand Pesos (Php25,000.00) for each elderly parent to the taxpayer where the elderly parent is chiefly dependent on and living with the taxpayer.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A HOSPITAL FOR TEACHERS AND THEIR DEPENDENTS, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Establishes a hospital for teachers which shall be the primary medical facility for the hospitalization and medical care of teachers and their dependents.

Mandates each regional hospital to establish a teachers´ ward with an initial capacity of at least fifty (50) beds which will provides hospital and medical care to teachers and their dependents residing outside of the National Capital Region.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING PROGRAMS FOR INCARCERATED MOTHERS AND THEIR CHILDREN
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT DEVELOPING GLOBALLY COMPETITIVE SCIENCE AND MATHEMATICS TEACHERS
rows.abstract: Seeks to attract above-average student and science graduates who majored in science or mathematics to join the teaching profession as science and mathematics teachers which shall have among others the following incentives: a.) priority in government scholarship grants; b.) temporary waiver of the requirement under Section 13, Art. III of RA 7836 to undergo the written Licensure Examination for Teachers to allow new graduates to be employed as science and mathematics teachers; c.) to teach in public and elementary and secondary schools for not more than three years d.) specialized continuing education and training in science and mathematics teaching; e.) rewards and recognition in cash and in kind for the top twenty slots in the LET; and f.) a starting salary grade, two grades higher than of a regular teacher.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 2019-09-03

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO CONSERVE AND PROTECT PHILIPPINE PUBLIC FORESTS, MANGROVES AND WILDLIFE THROUGH A COMPREHENSIVE ENVIRONMENTAL PROGRAM OF RENEWAL, REPLANTING AND REFORESTATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Creates a Coordinating Council for the Conservation, Protection and Renewal of the Nation´s Patrimony that shall formulate policies and develop projects to implement the national policy and program framework to carry out the purposes of this Act; and promulgate rules and regulations and adopt a code of services and guidelines to conserve, protect and renew the nation´s patrimony. 

Encourages students and community youth below twenty-five (25) years old to render service as provided in this Act. Students who will render such service may be credited with the required units for the National Service Training Program.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATURAL RESOURCES since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING HARASSMENT AND INVASION OF PRIVACY FOR COMMERCIAL PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Seeks to penalize any person who shall commit harassment against any person for commercial purposes by: a.) Reclusion temporal and a fine of Fifty Thousand Pesos, if death is caused by such harassment; b.) Prison mayor and a fine of Twenty Thousand Pesos, if seriously bodily injury is proximately caused by such harassment; and c.) Arresto mayor and a fine of One Thousand Pesos, if neither death nor serious bodily injury is proximately caused by such harassment.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT ABSOLUTELY PROHIBITING THE USE OF MINES, BOOBY-TRAPS AND OTHER DEVICES, PROVIDING FOR A TOTAL BAN ON ANTI-PERSONNEL LANDMINES AND CREATING FOR THIS PURPOSE A COORDINATING COMMITTEE ON LANDMINES
rows.abstract:
Provides restrictions and prohibitions 1.) on the use of mines, booby-traps or other devices; 2.) to develop, produce, acquire, retain or transfer to anyone anti-personnel mines; and 3.) to assist, encourage or induce, anyone to engage in any activity prohibited under this Act, with corresponding penalties thereof.

Mandates the Armed Forces of the Philippines to effect the corresponding charges in its military doctrine, issue military instructions and operating procedures in arms development, production, acquisition and transfer, receive training to comply with the provisions of this Act, develop and use alternatives to anti-personnel mines for perimeter defense of its detachments, and ensure that reacquisition of claymore mines are usable and used in command-detonated mode only.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE AND SECURITY since 2019-07-23

rows.author: E016
rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING A DEPARTMENT OF FISHERIES AND AQUATIC RESOURCES, PROVIDING FOR ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Aims to create a Department that shall have primary jurisdiction over the management, conservation, development, protection, utilization and disposition of all fishery and aquatic resources of the country, including the habitats of fish and all other marine life and over activities which impacts on these habitats. It shall also have the authority to supervise and regulate the production and capture of fish and fishery products, as well as the processing and marketing of all fisheries and aquatic products in the country and the responsibility of rationalizing all ocean sector initiatives which impact on fish and marine resources or their habitat.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 2019-07-23

rows.mother_status: REPUBLIC ACT RA11784 (Lapsed into law on 2022-05-29)

rows.status: Substituted by HB05738

rows.author: F081
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 10 OF REPUBLIC ACT 7832 OTHERWISE KNOWN AS AN ACT PENALIZING THE PILFERAGE OF AND THEFT OF POWER TRANSMISSION LINES/MATERIALS, RATIONALIZING SYSTEM LOSSES BY PHASING OUT PILFERAGE A COMPONENT THEREOF, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Provides that “ THE COSTS OF SYSTEM LOSSES SHALL NOT BE CHARGEABLE OR PASSED ON TO THE CONSUMERS AND SHALL  BE FOR THE ACCOUNT OF THE PRIVATE ELECTRIC UTILITIES AND/OR RURAL ELECTRIC COOPERATIVES.”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on ENERGY since 2019-07-23

rows.author: F081
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE CONDUCT OF HYBRID NATIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTIONS, THROUGH MANUAL VOTING AND COUNTING AT THE PRECINCT LEVEL, AND AUTOMATED TRANSMISSION AND CANVASSING, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Seeks to address the unsatisfactory observations on the conduct of the “automated” national and local elections and the “glitches” involving the electronic transmission of canvass, SD cards, and the use of ballot markers through manual voting and counting at the precinct level and automated transmission and canvassing.

Provides for the manner of filing of Certificates of Candidacy; the Printing of Official Ballots; Authentication of Ballot; the Counting of Votes; the Counting, Filling Out and Distribution of Election Returns; the Canvassing of Election Return, among others.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SUFFRAGE AND ELECTORAL REFORMS since 2019-07-23

rows.author: F081
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING MOVIE THEATER OPERATORS NATIONWIDE TO RUN MTRCB APPROVED AND RATED LOCAL MOVIES TO SUPPORT LOCAL MOVIE PRODUCERS AND PROMOTE ORIGINAL FILIPINO MOVIES
rows.abstract: Mandates the movie theatre operators to: a.) run MTRCB approved and rated local movies at the minimum span of five (5) consecutive days to support local movie producers; b.) equally divide theatre screening slots between local films (40%) and foreign films (60%); c.) equally divide movie trailer slots, 50% local film and 50% foreign film movie trailers, prior to the actual film screening of a featured movie; and d.) make Fridays as start of movie play dates, instead of Wednesdays, to give local movies a better fighting chance in the Box Office.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC INFORMATION since 2019-07-23

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PHILIPPINE SCIENCE HIGH SCHOOL CAMPUS IN THE SOUTHERN TAGALOG REGION AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY since 2019-07-23

rows.author: F081
rows.title_full: AN ACT GRANTING 20% DISCOUNT ON TRAVEL TAX TO SENIOR CITIZENS AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TOURISM since 2019-07-23

rows.author: I075
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT TO ALLOCATE FUNDS FOR POTABLE WATER ACCESS AND THE CONSTRUCTION OF WATER SYSTEMS IN ALL BARANGAYS, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Mandates the construction and implementation of  the necessary water systems and water facilities on a per-area or region basis to cater to all barangays, the poorest  local government units and barangays having the highest priority, as determined by the DOH, LWUA, DPWH, and such other agencies that have data and studies on the matter.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on PUBLIC WORKS AND HIGHWAYS since 2019-07-23

rows.author: I075
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING COMPENSATION FOR BARANGAY OFFICIALS, AMENDING SECTION 393 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS êžŒTHE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991êžŒ, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Provides the following monthly compensation, in addition to benefits provided by Law, for Barangays Officials:
a.) P12,000 for the Punong Barangay
b.) P8,000 for the seven (7) Sangguniang Barangay Members
c.) P6,000 for the Barangay Secretary 
d.) P6,000 for the Barangay Treasurer
e.) P2,000 for every Member of the Lupong Tagapamayapa, Barangay Health Workers, and the Barangay Tanods
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2019-07-23

rows.author: I058
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING DISCRIMINATION ON THE BASIS OF SEXUAL ORIENTATION OR GENDER IDENTITY OR EXPRESSION (SOGIE) AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to define, prohibit and penalize situations and practices wherein discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity occur. It also aims to protect members of the LGBT community and guarantee their rights as citizens of the Republic of the Philippines and their rights as human beings.

Enumerates different discriminatory practices to any person on the basis of sexual orientation or gender identity or expression as defined in this Act; Provides a complaint mechanism for SOGIE-related cases; Orders government to promote equality; and Empowers the portrayal of LGBT persons in media.
rows.status: Deliberated upon by the Mother Committee on 2020-11-04

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING POLICIES FOR THE PROTECTION AND WELFARE OF CAREGIVERS IN THE PRACTICE OF THEIR PROFESSION
rows.abstract:
Provides for an employment contract between the caregiver and the employer before the commencement of the service in a language or dialect understood by both parties.
Enumerates the duties of the caregivers. Provides eight (8) working hour shift,  payment of wages, leave benefits and other benefits, and basic necessities for caregivers, among others.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-11-23, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-11-24 and received by the Senate on 2020-11-24

rows.author: I089
rows.title_full: AN ACT IMPOSING STIFFER PENALTIES FOR CHILD ABUSE, EXPLOITATION AND DISCRIMINATION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7610, AS AMENDED
rows.title_short: Act Imposing Stiffer Penalties For Child Abuse, Exploitation And Discrimination
rows.abstract:
Seeks to update and provide stiffer penalties imposed for child abuse, exploitation and discrimination in order to secure the wholesome rearing of our children for them to be protected and to become good citizens of our country.

Increases penalties for any person committing the following acts: 1. Participation in production of obscene and indecent shows 2. Other acts of abuse, cruelty or exploitation and other conditions prejudicial to the child´s development 3. Child labor practices 4. Child trafficking 5. Discrimination of children of indigenous cultural communities.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2020-02-17, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-02-18 and received by the Senate on 2020-02-18

rows.abstract:
Seeks to safeguard the access of informal settlers to their employment and their market for their business through the adoption of an “on-site, in-city, near city” housing policy on resettlement.

Mandates a formulation of the “People´s Plan” which shall ensure a constant participation and partnership with informal settler families in achieving the sustainability and the continuity of the resettlement program.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RENTAL SUBSIDY PROGRAM FOR INFORMAL SETTLER FAMILIES (ISFS) AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Establishes a housing and social protection program for the ISFs to lead decent lives and access to the formal housing market .

Provides flat-rate rental subsidy to eligible low-income ISFs to rent accommodation in the private rental market for a maximum of five (5) years or upon availment of permanent housing, whichever comes first.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING A NATIONAL LAND USE AND MANAGEMENT POLICY, PROVIDING THE IMPLEMENTING MECHANISMS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Establishes a framework wherein various land uses shall be determined in a manner that promotes the policies and principles of land allocation and utilization. 

Creates the National Land Use Policy Council (NLUPC) which shall act as the highest policy-making body on land use and shall resolve land use policy conflict between or among agencies, branches, or levels of the government, and integrate efforts and monitor developments relating to land use and the evolution policies.
rows.alias_name: “National Land Use and Management Act of the Philippines”
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LAND USE since 2019-07-23

rows.abstract:
Provides Local Government Unit or the proper agency the power to identify and prioritize the particular area to be acquired for socialized housing. Exempts parcels of land owned by small property owners from expropriation for purposes of this Act. 

Ensures that the intended beneficiaries of RA7279 will enjoy the benefits of this Act.

rows.abstract: Seeks to define, prohibit and penalize situations and practices wherein discrimination on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity occur. It also aims to protect members of the LGBT community and guarantee their rights as citizens of the Republic of the Philippines and their rights as human beings. Enumerates different discriminatory practices to any person on the basis of sexual orientation or gender identity or expression as defined in this Act; Provides a complaint mechanism for SOGIE-related cases; Orders government to promote equality; and Empowers the portrayal of LGBT persons in media.

rows.abstract: Aims to spell out the rights and freedoms of the Human Rights Defenders (HRDs), the obligations of the State and public authorities for the protection of such rights, the creation and composition of the Human Rights Defenders Protection Committee tasked to enforce these obligations, and the penalties for the violations of this Act.

rows.author: H017
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NATIONAL CENTER AND AN INTER-AGENCY COUNCIL FOR HARM REDUCTION, PROVIDING FOR DIVERSION AND HARM-REDUCTION PROGRAM FOR PERSONAL USE AND LOW-LEVEL POSSESSION OF DRUGS, PROHIBITING HARMFUL AND DISCRIMINATORY DRUG-RELATED INTERVENTIONS AND PRACTICES, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract:
Aims to reduce the adverse health, social and economic consequences related to the use of legal and illegal psychoactive drugs without focusing on drug consumption by creating a National Center for Harm Reduction which shall plan and implement an integrated and comprehensive harm reduction approach to drug-related issues in the country. 

Provides diversion and harm reduction programs to person who personally use drugs and with low-level possession of drugs and drugs paraphernalia who qualifies under this Act the following procedures: a.) Education and outreach; b.) Referral to health and social services c.) Peer support and mentorship program; d.) Safe paraphernalia distribution programs; e.) Drug substitution treatment; and f.) Integrative Harm Reduction Psychotherapy.

Prohibits discriminatory and harmful drug-related interventions and practices and provides penalties for violation of this Act.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on HEALTH since 2019-07-23

rows.author: H017
rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2020-06-02, transmitted to the Senate on 2020-06-03 and received by the Senate on 2020-06-03
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A COMPREHENSIVE RENAL REPLACEMENT THERAPY (RRT) FOR PATIENTS WITH END STAGE RENAL DISEASE IN NATIONAL, REGIONAL, AND PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT HOSPITALS, INCREASING THE PHILHEALTH PACKAGE RATE FOR RENAL REPLACEMENT THERAPY OF MEMBERS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Mandates all national, provincial, and regional government hospitals, including all stand alone dialysis facilities to establish, operate and maintain a dialysis service facility, including peritoneal dialysis and hemodialysis, in their hospital.

Establishes a Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) prevention strategies and health promotion activities which include: advocacy activities targeting relatives of dialysis patients who are at high risk for developing 
CKD themselves, the provision of instructional materials and regular educational activities on the common symptoms of kidney disease, common tests to diagnose kidney disease, causes of kidney failure, and advisories on the appropriate protocols for the diagnostic evaluation of possible kidney disease.
rows.status: Substituted by HB06803

rows.abstract:
Provides for a six-month education and training program, free of charge,  for community-based health workers  that shall train them as healthcare provider, community organizer, health service manager, trainer and education, and researcher.

Increases the monthly basic pay of BHW to six thousand pesos (Php6,000.00) including incentives and benefits provided under the Magna Carta for Public Health Workers and shall be given burial and disability assistance in case of death or illness which results to disability, among others.

rows.mother_status: Republic Act RA11524 enacted on 2021-02-26
rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE COCONUT FARMERS AND INDUSTRY DEVELOPMENT TRUST FUND AND PROVIDING FOR ITS MANAGEMENT AND UTILIZATION
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create a trust fund to be maintained for a period not to exceed thirty (30) years or until the fund is fully utilized which shall be used exclusively for the ultimate benefit of coconut farmers and for the development of the coconut industry.

Provides for a Ten Billion Pesos (Php 10,000,000,000.00) Jumpstart Fund which may be used within two (2) years commencing from the approval of the Plan by the President to jumpstart the development of the industry; Creates the Coconut Farmers and Industry Trust Fund Committee to coordinate and monitor the implementation of the Coconut Farmers and Industry Development Plan; Conducts complete accounting and inventory of all Coconut Levy Assets by the PCGG; Allows audit by the Commission on Audit on the inventory of the Coconut Levy Assets prepared by the PCGG; and allows privatization of non-cash coconut levy assets  which shall be determine by the Governance Commission for Government-Owned or Controlled Corporations.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08136

rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE NATIONAL PROGRAM FOR THE ELIMINATION OF TUBERCULOSIS AS A PUBLIC HEALTH PROBLEM, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10767 OR THE êžŒCOMPREHENSIVE TUBERCULOSIS ELIMINATION PLAN ACTêžŒ
rows.abstract:
This bill provides the following salient features: provisions on patients right and responsibilities, corporate social responsibility to encourage business corporations to contribute in the continuing efforts to reduce the incidence of TB in the country; convergence of services to address the problem of indirect costs borne out of accessing TB treatment; TB Strategic Plan for local government units; integration of TB services into established Service Delivery Networks or local health referral system; and inclusion of TB-DOTS treatment as one of the requirements for the conditional cash transfer program.

It also provides fines and penalties for non-compliance to the “No prescription, No anti-TB drugs” policy and non-observance of the national protocol on TB management and TB notification. Further, it  expands PhilHealth´s benefit package for TB patients to include TB screening, MDR TB, and XDR TB, in both adults and children.

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING A COMPREHENSIVE RENAL REPLACEMENT THERAPY (RRT) FOR PATIENTS WITH END STAGE RENAL DISEASE IN NATIONAL, REGIONAL, AND PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT HOSPITALS, INCREASING THE PHILHEALTH PACKAGE RATE FOR RENAL REPLACEMENT THERAPY OF MEMBERS AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to make comprehensive renal replacement therapy services available to all Filipinos who suffer from End Stage Kidney Disease by including it in the coverage of treatment services provided by PhilHealth. It also supports kidney transplantation as the best treatment option that provides the quality of life of End Stage Renal Disease patients and ensures the return of the patient to full rehabilitation.

Provides the following key provisions, among others: expansion of PhilHealth benefit package for kidney transplantation or renal replacement therapy from  the living donors; free dialysis to indigent patients;  provision for the PCSO to pay for the remaining sessions for both peritoneal dialysis and hemodialysis  after a patient has already consumed his or her benefit package from PhilHealth.

rows.title_full: AN ACT SETTING THE MINIMUM PAID-UP CAPITAL AND LOCALLY PRODUCED STOCK INVENTORY REQUIREMENTS FOR FOREIGN RETAIL BUSINESS ENTERPRISES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE REPUBLIC ACT NO. 8762, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE êžŒRETAIL TRADE LIBERALIZATION ACT OF 2000êžŒ
rows.abstract:
Seeks to allow foreign-owned partnerships, associations and corporations to engage or invest in the retail trade business with a minimum paid-up capital of the equivalent in Phil. Peso of Two Hundred Thousand US Dollars (US$200,000.00).

Proposes several salient features of the bill: a) removal of several requirements for foreign investors to acquire shares of stock of local retailers and for public offering of shares of stock by foreign-owned retail enterprises. b) permit only nationals from or juridical entities formed or incorporated in countries which allow the entry of Filipino retailers to engage in retail trade in the Phils.; and c) reduce the required locally manufactured products carried by foreign retailers from 30% to 10% of the aggregate cost of their stock inventory.
rows.status: Consolidated into HB00059

rows.title_full: AN ACT CREATING THE DEPARTMENT OF DISASTER RESILIENCE, DEFINING ITS POWERS AND FUNCTIONS, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create the Department which shall be the primary agency responsible for managing the national effort to reduce disaster risk; and prepare for and respond to disasters, recovery and rehabilitation.

Intends to augment the capacity of the local government units, in collaboration with relevant national government agencies and stakeholders to implement disaster risk reduction and management; and climate change action plans, programs, projects and activities.

Proposes for the creation of the National Disaster Resilience Council, which will serve as the policy advisory body to the Department; and establishes Multi-Stakeholders Convergence Unit; Climate and Disaster Research, Education, and Training Institute; and National and Regional Information 
Management System for Climate and Disaster Resilience.
